source_version_proposals.title: Security of Critical Infrastructure (Definitions) Rules (LIN 21/039) 2021
source_version_proposals.extraction_proposal: supporting-only; zero standalone requirements, definitions/recipient dependency

requirements.requirement_summary: When the complete statutory critical incident trigger is satisfied for a covered asset and its responsible entity, give ASD an incident report including information prescribed by the rules, as soon as practicable and in any event within 12 hours after the entity becomes so aware. The initial report may be oral or written; if written, use the approved form.
applicable_actor: Responsible entity for an asset to which Part 2B applies, as defined by the actual asset class and s12L
applicability_conditions: Part 2B must apply to the asset under s30BB: the applicable rules or a s51 declaration, subject to any s30BB(3) / Application Rules r5(5) grace period.
The asset and responsible entity must satisfy ss9 and 12L and the applicable class definitions/rules. Sectors under s8D are not automatically Part 2B asset coverage.
Apply the constitutional/entity scope in s13 and the extraterritorial provision in s14 together with s9(2B) outside-Australia asset limitation and ss9(2C)-(2D) satellite/submarine-cable exceptions.
Use cyber security incident in s12M and unauthorised access/modification/impairment in s12N, including the actual entitlement, employee/agent scope and authorised-law-enforcement qualifications.

Report recipient is ASD under s30BF read with Definitions Rules r18. The Department is specified only for ss30BC(5) and 30BD(5) written-record exemption powers; it is not substituted as the ordinary report recipient.
The responsible entity becomes aware that a cyber security incident has occurred or is occurring.
The entity becomes aware that the incident has had or is having a significant direct or indirect impact on asset availability.

Significant impact is the if-and-only-if test in s30BEA: material disruption of essential goods/services supplied using the asset, or circumstances specified in rules. Imminence alone is not this trigger.
timing_or_frequency: As soon as practicable and in any event within 12 hours after the specified awareness trigger.
required_artefacts: Incident report, with information (if any) prescribed by rules; approved form if submitted in writing.
exceptions_or_qualifications: The written-record exemption under subsection (5) concerns the oral-report follow-up duty under subsection (3), not the initial notification duty.
s30BE supplies specified good-faith damages protections; this is not a general immunity from reporting duties or every form of liability.
constituent_propositions: Give the incident report to the statutory recipient.
Include information, if any, prescribed by rules.
Meet both as-soon-as-practicable and outer-limit timing.
Where the initial report is written, use the approved form.

relationship_proposals.invariant: Conduct subject to a required governance route may reach execution only through that route or an authorised equivalent preserving the same control effect. Direct, alternate, fallback, delegated, asynchronous, tool-mediated, and cross-runtime paths require route-equivalence validation before proceeding.
relationship_proposals.supported_component: The legally required incident report must traverse the prescribed ASD recipient route with its source-defined form and timing conditions.

relationship_proposals.invariant: A material governance signal must carry an accountable owner, capable destination, status, response expectation, and escalation route, and remain tracked until it produces the required effect or receives an authorised disposition. Emission, acknowledgement, or storage at an incapable endpoint is not completion.
relationship_proposals.supported_component: The reporting obligation has an identified responsible actor and capable statutory recipient; the oral-report follow-up preserves the required written signal beyond initial emission.

excluded_candidates.disposition: Absorbed as conditional approved-form constituents of initial reporting. A format rule alone is not forced into an independent governance-route class.
Use as a definitional qualification on the incident trigger; retain contextual authority-boundary comparison, not an invented freestanding prohibition.
Recipient and exemption-authority qualifications, not a new independent oversight guarantee.
Preserve bounded good-faith damages protection as a qualification, not a generic immunity requirement.

excluded_candidates.provisions: Other SOCI parts, risk-management duties, government assistance or systems-of-national-significance powers
excluded_candidates.disposition: Outside bounded notification extraction; do not expand admission merely because the Act contains them.

relationship_exclusions.disposition: Contextual trigger/activation comparison only. A legal reporting duty does not itself establish an implemented available control.
No supported oversight-independence equivalence from recipient designation alone.
No dependency-as-authority or access-concession proposition established by the selected reporting provisions.

approval_requested: Admit the three exact source versions and four bounded Act propositions, with the six retained strong-supporting component relationships, after reconciling the remote Gate 1 implementation dependency. No Incident edits, new schema/controls, PR merge or deployment included.
